verdict.rationale: Runloop's own docs cover each step an agent needs. SDKs and the CLI manage the devbox lifecycle, agents can run code inside devboxes, logs can be streamed or retrieved after execution, and automatic shutdown is configurable, so the whole loop can be driven without a human. missing for 10: an explicitly documented programmatic delete/teardown call (only shutdown behavior and 'devbox lifecycle' are evidenced), a single documented agent-driven provision→execute→read→teardown walkthrough outside benchmarks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, my agent can provision its own sandbox, execute code, read the results, and tear it down — end to end without a human

citations.quote: Runloop Devboxes provide a full-featured execution environment for your AI agents.
covering devbox lifecycle, file operations, command execution, blueprints, snapshots, tunnels, and more.
Empower your agents to run code inside a devbox.
Stream logs in real-time or retrieve logs from completed executions
Control devbox automatic shutdown and idle behaviors
let Runloop handle everything: provisioning devboxes, running agents, scoring results, and aggregating outputs.
